descriptionChirho: Attributive or predicative adjective describing something or someone as set apart, sacred, or consecrated to God, including superlative intensification.
Substantive singular use referring to the Holy Spirit (πνεῦμα ἅγιον), the Holy One of God, or divine holiness as a personal attribute.
Substantive plural use referring to God's people, believers, or the consecrated community (οἱ ἅγιοι).
Substantive neuter use referring to sacred spaces such as the temple, sanctuary, or the holy of holies (τὰ ἅγια, ἅγια ἁγίων).
